title: Cold rebuild: Search with optional filters
summary: Rebuild Search with optional filters from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Search with optional filters** in *Filtering, sorting, paging, grouping*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

code: var leGuin = new Author { Name = "Le Guin", Country = "US" };
var herbert = new Author { Name = "Herbert", Country = "US" };
var austen = new Author { Name = "Austen", Country = "UK" };
new Book { Title = "Earthsea", Year = 1968, Pages = 183, Genre = "Fantasy", Author = leGuin },
new Book { Title = "The Dispossessed", Year = 1974, Pages = 387, Genre = "SciFi", Author = leGuin },
new Book { Title = "Dune", Year = 1965, Pages = 412, Genre = "SciFi", Author = herbert },
new Book { Title = "Emma", Year = 1815, Pages = 474, Genre = "Classic", Author = austen },
new Book { Title = "Persuasion", Year = 1817, Pages = 249, Genre = "Classic", Author = austen });
public Author Author { get; set; } = null!;
protected override void OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder options) => options.UseSqlite("Data Source=library.db");
steps.explain: SciFi gives Dune and The Dispossessed; under 200 pages adds Earthsea. Herbert sorts before Le Guin, and within Le Guin the newer book (1974) comes first.

steps.title: Rebuild Search with optional filters cold
prompt: The tests give you the model from the last lesson:
class Author { int Id; string Name; string Country; List<Book> Books; }
class Book   { int Id; string Title; int Year; int Pages; string Genre; int AuthorId; Author Author; }

The tests fill it with five books: Earthsea (Le Guin, 1968, 183 pages, Fantasy), The Dispossessed (Le Guin, 1974, 387, SciFi), Dune (Herbert, 1965, 412, SciFi), Emma (Austen, 1815, 474, Classic) and Persuasion (Austen, 1817, 249, Classic). Le Guin and Herbert are from the US, Austen from the UK.
Write `List<string> Search(LibraryDb db, string? term, string? genre, int page, int pageSize)`:
- `term` (if not null): the title contains it, ignoring case (compare `ToLower()` of both),
Build the query step by step: start from `db.Books`, add a `Where` for each filter that was given, then sort and page. Everything must run in SQL.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
Type the shape yourself, then fill it in:
List<string> Search(LibraryDb db, string? term, string? genre, int page, int pageSize)
